title: The Sims 2
summary: A matching decompilation of The Sims 2 for GameCube. Follow the work of reconstructing the game's original executable as readable C++.
boardNote: The linked decomp.dev page reported that this project was disabled when checked on October 17, 2026. Its displayed percentages may be stale. Check the repository for current status.
note: The upstream README distinguishes a byte-identical linked DOL from fully reconstructed source. Some bytes can still come from the original binary; a successful build alone does not measure handwritten C++ coverage.

title: Ocarina of Time
summary: A decompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Read the current project guidance for contributing, documentation, and community support.
boardNote: Progress is maintained by the upstream project on its own dashboard. Open that dashboard for current measurements.
note: Follow the upstream version and toolchain instructions before choosing a function. A tutorial or documentation improvement can also be a useful contribution.

title: Super Mario 64
summary: The Super Mario 64 decompilation project. Its README describes completed decompilation, with naming and documentation work still welcome.
boardNote: No separate progress board is listed here. The repository's contribution guidance describes its remaining work.
note: A completed decompilation can still need better names, documentation, and understanding. Read the current contribution rules before opening a pull request.

title: Pokémon Emerald
summary: The Pokémon Emerald decompilation project from pret. Start with the installation guide, then follow the repository's pull request checklist.
boardNote: No separate progress board is listed here. The upstream repository is the source for setup and contribution requirements.
note: Use the upstream installation guide for the current toolchain. Review its pull request template before submitting a change.
